title: Apps on this Mac
description: ~/.ultimate-tester/apps.json: the repos Ultimate Tester knows on this Mac. Never committed or shared. Each repo's own per-Mac data (saved sign-ins, test runs, setup questions) lives in that repo's .ultimate-tester/ folder, which git ignores.

root.description: Where the repo is on this Mac.

remote.description: The repo's git address as host/owner/name, no scheme or login, so a plan's backends can find it. null when the repo has no remote.
